title: Peurangkông Bumoe .
intro: Lam masa cobaan nyang rayeuk, sidroe ureueng nyang terkenal geubri keukayaan donya nyang that rayeuk, saboh ujian rasa syukur dan kerendahan hate. Perjalanan tokoh nyoe jeut keu saboh peulajaran nyang mendalam teuntang sifeut siat harta benda dan akibat dari kesombongan. Buka identitas jiwa njoë njang kisah djih ka meu-ukheuë dalam tanoh di mijub geutanjoë.
clues: Ulôn tinggai lamkawan saboh bansa nyang geubimbéng lé sidroe utusan nyang rayeuk.
Allah geubri keu ulôn hareuta njang that rajek sampoë kunci-kunci harta ulôn njan djeuët keu beuban njang brat that keu le that ureuëng njang teuga.

Umat ​​ulôn, sabab djiteupeuë keukayaan ulôn, djibri naseuhat untôk ulôn mita teumpat tinggai akhirat deungon peuë njang ka neubri lé Allah dan bèk tuwo keu ulôn nibak dônja, dan untôk peubuët djroh lagèë Allah ka neubri djroh keu ulôn.
Lon deungon sombong lon peugah bahwa keukayaan lon yang that rayeuk nyan lon teume hanya melalui pengetahuan dan usaha lon keudroe, lon tulak nikmat ilahi.
Watèë geulakèë sumbangan atawa geuakui karunia Allah, ulôn deungon bangga lôn tulak, lôn peucaya hareuta ulôn nakeuh hareuta ulôn mantong.
Akibat nibak keusombongan dan keuzaliman ulôn njang that-that, Allah neupeurintah bumoë supaja djibuka dan djiteubiët ulôn dan teumpat tinggai ulôn.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
